label: acceleration from low speed
physical_definition: a run of frames with tangential acceleration ≥ 1 yd/s² lasting ≥ 0.5 s with a speed gain ≥ 1.5 yd/s, starting below 2 yd/s
features: v_start, v_max, speed_change, duration_s, distance_yd, mean_accel, peak_rate_05, acc_2_4, acc_4_6
comparability: same speed bands, same 10 Hz first-crossing rule; the forty starts from rest at maximal effort
limitation: game movement is rarely maximal: it follows role, opportunity and play context; the 2 → 4 yd/s band spans few frames at 10 Hz

label: acceleration from intermediate speed
physical_definition: a run of frames with tangential acceleration ≥ 1 yd/s² lasting ≥ 0.5 s with a speed gain ≥ 1.5 yd/s, starting at 2–5 yd/s
features: v_start, v_max, speed_change, duration_s, distance_yd, mean_accel, peak_rate_05, acc_4_6, acc_6_8
comparability: same speed bands; in the forty the athlete passes through the band once, already accelerating
limitation: game movement is rarely maximal: it follows role, opportunity and play context; a standing-start band transit is not a rolling-start acceleration

label: transition into high-speed running
physical_definition: a run of frames with tangential acceleration ≥ 1 yd/s² lasting ≥ 0.5 s with a speed gain ≥ 1.5 yd/s, starting at ≥ 5 yd/s and reaching 7.5 yd/s
features: v_start, v_max, speed_change, duration_s, distance_yd, mean_accel, acc_6_8
limitation: game movement is rarely maximal: it follows role, opportunity and play context; positions that rarely reach the line have few episodes

label: sustained high-speed running
comparability: largest speed reached: tracked top speed of the forty against the peak speed of the episode
limitation: game movement is rarely maximal: it follows role, opportunity and play context; an observed game speed is not a physical maximum

label: speed maintenance
physical_definition: |tangential acceleration| < 1 yd/s² at ≥ 5 yd/s for ≥ 1 s
comparability: none: forty recordings usually end at or before the speed peak (last-frame censoring)
limitation: no maintenance phase is recorded in the forty

label: braking and deceleration
physical_definition: a run with tangential acceleration ≤ −1 yd/s² for ≥ 0.4 s from ≥ 4 yd/s with a speed drop ≥ 2 yd/s
features: v_start, speed_change, duration_s, distance_yd, mean_accel, peak_rate_05
comparability: none: the forty contains no braking phase inside the timed run
limitation: contact and the end of a play also produce decelerations that are not braking

label: acceleration following deceleration
physical_definition: a run of frames with tangential acceleration ≥ 1 yd/s² lasting ≥ 0.5 s with a speed gain ≥ 1.5 yd/s, starting within 1 s after a braking episode
features: v_start, v_max, speed_change, duration_s, mean_accel, peak_rate_05
comparability: none: the forty contains no braking, so no re-acceleration
limitation: no validated manoeuvre label; the braking rule is a provisional threshold

label: directional redirection
physical_definition: |heading change| ≥ 45° at |yaw rate| ≥ 60 deg/s and speed ≥ 3 yd/s, every frame with a valid heading
comparability: none: the forty is a straight run
limitation: magnitude only (handedness of the frame unverified); heading is the direction of MOTION, not body orientation

label: repeated speed-change sequence
physical_definition: a player-play with ≥ 2 accelerating episodes and ≥ 1 braking episode
comparability: none: a single maximal sprint has one acceleration phase
limitation: a count of episodes of this atlas, sensitive to its thresholds
